title: ⛏️💰Nothing Gold Can Stay: A thought experiment about money, wealth, power and the psychology of economy.

sentences.en: Hi, it's Joel Blackstock with the Taproot Therapy Collective Podcast, and today I'm going to read an article from our blog at gettherapybirmingham.com called Nothing Gold Can Stay,
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是乔尔·布莱克史东（Joel Blackstock），这里是“主根疗法集体播客”（Taproot Therapy Collective Podcast）。今天，我将朗读我们博客 gettherapybirmingham.com 上的一篇文章，题目是《没有什么黄金能永存》，

sentences.en: a thought experiment about money, power, wealth, and the psychology of economy.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于金钱、权力、财富以及经济心理学的思想实验。

sentences.en: So, what do we value as people, as a society?
sentences.zh: 那么，作为个人，作为社会，我们究竟珍视什么？

sentences.en: It's important to note that in this article,
sentences.zh: 需要指出的是，在这篇文章中，

sentences.en: this is a thought experiment for the purpose of reconsidering our implicit assumptions and societal conceptions of the necessities for civilization and the norms that make us human.
sentences.zh: 这是一个思想实验，旨在重新审视我们对文明必需品以及使我们成为人类的规范的内隐假设和社群观念。

sentences.en: In the article or the podcast about mysticism, I pointed out that I was a psychotherapist and not a theologian.
sentences.zh: 在关于神秘主义的那篇文章或播客中，我指出过我是一名心理治疗师，而不是神学家。

sentences.en: And here, I need to point out that I am not an economist either.
sentences.zh: 而在这里，我需要指出的是，我也不是经济学家。

sentences.en: This is a thought experiment, and it is not advocating for any kind of specific new political or economic reality.
sentences.zh: 这是一个思想实验，它并不主张任何特定类型的新政治或经济现实。

sentences.en: Instead, it's a way to consider the things that we take for granted and meditate on new ideas that might allow us to conceive of a healthier or more stable society.
sentences.zh: 相反，这是一种思考理所当然的事物的方式，并借此沉思那些可能让我们构想出一个更健康或更稳定的社会的新理念。

sentences.en: So, if we didn't have gold, if we didn't have the noble metals on the periodic table, like iridium and silver and platinum, that are not very reactive,
sentences.zh: 那么，如果我们没有黄金，如果我们没有元素周期表上那些像铱、银和铂这样不太活泼的贵金属，

sentences.en: what would money have looked like?
sentences.zh: 货币会是什么样子？

sentences.en: You know, these metals are non-perishable, the precious metals, and there's not a lot of other goods that we can make that hold value in the way that they do.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些金属是不可腐烂的贵金属，而且没有多少其他商品能像它们那样保持价值。

sentences.en: So, they're in a small, convenient package, and they have a high luster and malleability, they don't spoil with age.
sentences.zh: 因此，它们小巧便携，具有高度的光泽和延展性，不会因岁月流逝而变质。

sentences.en: How would society store value without something like gold?
sentences.zh: 如果没有像黄金这样的东西，社会将如何储存价值？

sentences.en: Well, there are a couple examples of how money developed in places without gold, and my favorite is an island called Yap, where there was little to no money.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一些关于没有黄金的地方货币是如何发展的例子，我最喜欢的是一个叫做雅浦（Yap）的岛屿，那里几乎没有甚至根本没有货币。

sentences.en: It's a pre-industrial society that hadn't been discovered by any empire yet.
sentences.zh: 这是一个尚未被任何帝国发现的前工业化社会。

sentences.en: And so, the native yapis used these 20-foot-tall limestone discs that weighed hundreds of pounds for money.
sentences.zh: 因此，当地的雅浦人使用这些20英尺高、重达数百磅的石灰石圆盘作为货币。

sentences.en: So, how did this kind of money work?
sentences.zh: 那么，这种货币是如何运作的呢？

sentences.en: How do you put a 200-pound, or in some cases, like 500-pound stone tablet in your pocket or in a vending machine or slide it across a bar to use it as money?
sentences.zh: 你如何把一块200磅重、或者在某些情况下重达500磅的石碑放进你的口袋、自动售货机里，或者在酒吧里把它推过去当作钱用？

sentences.en: Well, the yapis never moved the stones that they used as money.
sentences.zh: 嗯，雅浦人从来没有搬动过他们用作货币的石头。

sentences.en: Instead, they kept an oral and societal ledger of who owned what stone, which is really all that's important about money is somebody remembering who owns it.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们保留了一份口头和社群账本，记录着谁拥有哪块石头，而关于金钱，真正重要的其实只是有人记住谁拥有它。

sentences.en: And so, money that can't fit into your wallet might seem like a crazy idea, but think about how your debit card works.
sentences.zh: 因此，塞不进钱包的钱听起来可能是一个疯狂的想法，但想想你的借记卡是如何运作的。

sentences.en: Because there's this collective ledger somewhere out there that changes every time you slide your card, even though no physical money is moved.
sentences.zh: 因为在某个地方存在着这样一个集体账本，每当你刷卡时它就会改变，尽管没有任何实物货币被移动。

sentences.en: And we really can't even keep track of it in our heads, but we trust that someone is doing it right, and collectively, you know, we all kind of do it the same way.
sentences.zh: 而且我们实际上甚至无法在脑海中追踪它，但我们相信有人在正确地处理它，并且从集体上讲，你知道，我们都以同样的方式在做这件事。

sentences.en: Anyway, that's how the money on Yap worked.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这就是雅浦货币的运作方式。

sentences.en: So, on this island of Yap, the acquisition and distribution of rye stones, rye is what they called the money, R-A-I, they were tied to social merit and prestige.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这个雅浦岛上，石币（他们称货币为rai，R-A-I）的获取和分配与社会威望和声誉息息相关。

sentences.en: So, somebody owned the money, no one could take it from them, it wasn't a communist society.
sentences.zh: 所以，有人拥有这笔钱，没有人能从他们手中夺走，这不是一个共产主义社会。

sentences.en: They got to choose who it gave the money to, but, you know, there's social pressures maybe in that same way there is in capitalism, you know, that you have to,
sentences.zh: 他们可以自由选择把钱给谁，但是，你知道，其中可能存在着类似于资本主义的那种社会压力，你知道，你必须，

sentences.en: if you're a billionaire, you have to start a nonprofit or you have to be benevolent in some way to make an argument for your worth in society.
sentences.zh: 如果你是个亿万富翁，你就必须创办一个非营利组织，或者必须以某种方式表现得仁慈，从而为你在社会中的价值进行辩护。

sentences.en: And so, this process of awarding the rye stones on the Yap Island, it was based on various factors that reflected an individual status, achievements,
sentences.zh: 因此，在雅浦岛上授予石币的过程，是基于反映个人地位、成就的各种因素，

sentences.en: and contributions to the community.
sentences.zh: 以及对社区的贡献。

sentences.en: Now, I mean, somebody could just take one and say, I'm never going to give it to anybody, I'm going to take all these, that was an option available.
sentences.zh: 当然，我的意思是，某人完全可以拿走一块并说：我绝不把它给任何人，我要拿走所有这些。这也是一种可行的选择。

sentences.en: But generally, there's this tendency in the money on Yap to give it to people who deserve it or who have given back to society in some meaningful way.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，雅浦货币有一种趋势，就是把它交给那些应得的人，或者以某种有意义的方式回馈社会的人。

sentences.en: So, the primary means of acquiring a rye stone was through social recognition and acknowledgement of an individual's accomplishments.
sentences.zh: 因此，获取石币的主要途径是通过社会认可和对个人成就的承认。

sentences.en: And these accomplishments could include successful leadership or an act of bravery or notable achievements in various fields like agricultural development, craftsmanship,
sentences.zh: 这些成就包括成功的领导力、勇敢的行为，或者在农业发展、手工艺、外交等各个领域的显著成就。

sentences.en: diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 外交。

sentences.en: And there seemed to be this respected method of noticing when somebody did this well and then somebody's stepping up to kind of pay them a rye stone.
sentences.zh: 而且似乎有一种备受推崇的方法，即注意到某人在这方面做得很好，然后由某人挺身而出，奖励他们一块石币。

sentences.en: Granted, these stones never moved.
sentences.zh: 当然，这些石头从未移动过。

sentences.en: Like, they sat there.
sentences.zh: 就像，它们就静静地呆在那里。

sentences.en: And the society said this new person owns this new stone.
sentences.zh: 而社会则宣布这个新的人拥有这块新石头。

sentences.en: There's even one story about how they were moving one of the stones in between the islands just to kind of transfer it.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一个故事，讲的是他们如何在岛屿之间搬运其中一块石头，只是为了转移它。

sentences.en: And it sank.
sentences.zh: 结果它沉了。

sentences.en: And everybody was like, well, okay, it sank into the ocean, but it's still there.
sentences.zh: 每个人都觉得：好吧，它沉入海底了，但它依然在那里。

sentences.en: So, I mean, we'll just keep it going.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我们会继续让它生效。

sentences.en: And so, you know, a group of people or a family or whatever at different points, they owned the stone that was under the ocean that no one would ever get back.
sentences.zh: 因此，你知道，一群人或一个家庭或无论什么人在不同的时期，都拥有那块沉在海底、谁也无法再取回的石头。

sentences.en: But it was still money, still there, still part of the system.
sentences.zh: 但它依然是钱，依然存在，依然是系统的一部分。

sentences.en: This is just one thought experiment about what money might look like without gold, but it's kind of an interesting one.
sentences.zh: 这只是关于如果没有黄金，货币会是什么样子的一次思想实验，但它确实是一个有趣的实验。

sentences.en: And so, this recognition of awarding rye stones to different people, it was carried out through public ceremonies and gatherings.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种向不同的人授予石币的认可，是通过公开仪式和集会来进行的。

sentences.en: And these events provided a platform for the community to acknowledge and celebrate the achievements of an individual.
sentences.zh: 这些活动为社区提供了一个平台，以承认和庆祝个人的成就。

sentences.en: The stones were typically presented by influential community leaders or elders who acted as arbiters of the social merit of the community, sometimes secular,
sentences.zh: 这些石头通常由有影响力的社区领袖或长老颁发，他们充当社区社会价值的仲裁者，有时是世俗的，

sentences.en: sometimes more religious.
sentences.zh: 有时更具宗教色彩。

sentences.en: And it's important to note, though, that the awarding of rye stones was not this purely individualistic pursuit, but it was rather a collective decision.
sentences.zh: 不过，需要指出的是，授予石币并非纯粹的个人主义追求，而是一种集体决定。

sentences.en: So, even though the individual owned it, the individual could reward it,
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管个人拥有它，个人可以奖励它，

sentences.en: there is social pressure that if you have not done a good job at something for a while and somebody else is doing a good job,
sentences.zh: 但存在着这样一种社会压力：如果你有一段时间没有把某件事做好而别人做得很好，

sentences.en: you probably need to give them a rye stone to compensate them.
sentences.zh: 你可能就需要给他们一块石币来补偿他们。

sentences.en: There's that pressure that's always acting on this monetary system.
sentences.zh: 这种压力始终作用于这个货币系统之中。

sentences.en: So, these rye stones, they were bestowed upon an individual, but they couldn't be hoarded or accumulated solely for personal wealth.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些石币被赐予个人，但它们不能被囤积或仅仅为了个人财富而累积。

sentences.en: It would be very hard, nigh impossible for somebody to own all of them in Yap culture.
sentences.zh: 在雅浦文化中，一个人要想拥有所有石币是极其困难的，几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: And so, this Yapese monetary system, it served as this tangible representation that rye stones did and the social contract that kept them moving.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个雅浦货币系统，它作为一种有形的代表，展示了石币的作用以及维持它们流动的社会契约。

sentences.en: It served as this tangible representation of honor and status, and it reinforced the social fabric and common good of the Yap society.
sentences.zh: 它作为荣誉和地位的有形代表，巩固了雅浦社会的社会结构和共同利益。

sentences.en: So, in answer to the original question, how could society store value without gold?
sentences.zh: 因此，为了回答最初的问题：社会如何在没有黄金的情况下储存价值？

sentences.en: I'm not going to bore you with like 800 examples of pre-industrial societies forming their own monetary system, even across sometimes pretty vast empires like in Africa.
sentences.zh: 我不会用前工业化社会形成自己货币系统的800个例子来烦你，即使这些系统有时跨越了相当广袤的帝国，比如在非洲。

sentences.en: Um, the, the answer is if you don't have a precious metal, what you usually revolve your society around storing wealth in is something like reputation or honor, social merit.
sentences.zh: 嗯，答案是，如果你没有贵金属，你通常围绕其来储存财富的社会核心是诸如声誉、荣誉或社会价值之类的事物。

sentences.en: There's a system that props up that rewards benevolence and generosity and innovation in the way that sometimes, um, you know,
sentences.zh: 存在这样一个系统，它推崇并奖励仁慈、慷慨和创新，而有时，嗯，你知道，

sentences.en: precious metal back systems or debt back systems don't do.
sentences.zh: 以贵金属为支撑的系统或以债务为支撑的系统并没有做到这一点。

sentences.en: And so the people who gave back to society the most in these pre-industrial societies,
sentences.zh: 因此，在这些前工业化社会中，对社会回馈最多的人，

sentences.en: they would be awarded the most value in the form of reputation and not by how many precious metals or how much debt or land or, you know, whatever the scarcity, uh, thing is,
sentences.zh: 他们将以声誉的形式被授予最大的价值，而不是取决于拥有多少贵金属、多少债务、多少土地，或者，你知道，任何稀缺的事物，

sentences.en: but reputation.
sentences.zh: 而是声誉。

sentences.en: So, how did something like gold change our conception of society and culture?
sentences.zh: 那么，像黄金这样的东西是如何改变我们对社会和文化的看法的呢？

sentences.en: So, gold has long fascinated humanity because it has this allure, um, it's very rare, um, it's needed for a lot of things, it's non-perishable in that, like, it doesn't go away.
sentences.zh: 所以，黄金长期以来一直让人类着迷，因为它有着这种诱惑力，嗯，它非常稀少，嗯，很多事情都需要它，它不会腐烂，也就是说，它不会消失。

sentences.en: Like, you can throw a bunch of gold in a dungeon and then a hobbit can come reclaim it in a thousand years, like, nothing happens to it if you do that with, like, wheat.
sentences.zh: 就像，你可以把一堆黄金扔进地牢里，然后一个霍比特人可以在一千年后回来把它取回，像，如果你对小麦这样做，什么都不会发生。

sentences.en: Or clothing or something, like, they'd be rotted and out of date and even buildings, you know, they require maintenance.
sentences.zh: 或者衣服之类的东西，它们会腐烂过时，甚至建筑物，你知道，它们都需要维护。

sentences.en: Like, if you leave a building for a thousand years, it's gone.
sentences.zh: 就像，如果你把一座建筑物放置一千年不管，它就彻底消失了。

sentences.en: So, there's nothing that really holds value in the way that gold does because gold's properties don't change.
sentences.zh: 因此，没有什么东西能真正像黄金那样保持价值，因为黄金的属性不会改变。

sentences.en: So, if there were a couple changes to the astrophysical geometry of our universe, um, we wouldn't have enough gold on this planet.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们的宇宙的天体物理几何结构发生了一点变化，嗯，我们这个星球上就没有足够的黄金了。

sentences.en: So, you know, why is gold on Earth and what is our relationship to it?
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，为什么地球上有黄金？我们与它又有着怎样的关系？

sentences.en: So, in a lot of psychology and myths, gold is representative of, um, the self.
sentences.zh: 因此，在许多心理学和神话中，黄金代表着，嗯，自我。

sentences.en: You know, you go on this trip to reclaim gold, but really along the way you find out who you are and it wasn't really about the treasure, it was about the journey.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你踏上这段旅程去寻回黄金，但实际上沿途你发现了你是谁，这其实并不是关于宝藏，而是关于这段旅程。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's part of our mythological systems and the way that we tell stories.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这是我们的神话系统以及我们讲故事的方式的一部分。

sentences.en: But why is the element of gold on our planet?
sentences.zh: 但是，为什么我们星球上会有黄金这种元素呢？

sentences.en: So, uh, when you look at, like, most noble metals, and again, like, I'm not a scientiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，当你看看，比如，大多数贵金属，再说一次，嗯，我不是科学家。

sentences.en: I'm sure somebody's going to say, like, well, there's a billion caveats.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定有人会说，嗯，这里有十亿个前提条件。

sentences.en: And there are, but I'm trying to make this simple.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，但我正试图把它简单化。

sentences.en: Like, most, uh, of those noble metals, like, they're not very reactive.
sentences.zh: 就像，大多数，嗯，那些贵金属，就像，它们不是很活泼。

sentences.en: Um, and that's because they come from the reactions inside of stars and they leave the star as gas because stars are just, like, these hydrogen processing, like,
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是因为它们来自恒星内部的反应，它们以气体的形式离开恒星，因为恒星就像是这些氢加工厂，就像，

sentences.en: it's the most reaction, chemical reactions that can ever take place in, like, one spot.
sentences.zh: 这是在同一个地方可能发生的最剧烈的化学反应。

sentences.en: And so, by the time something leaves, it's pretty reacted with, it's pretty inert.
sentences.zh: 因此，当某些东西离开时，它已经经历了相当多的反应，变得相当惰性。

sentences.en: And so, you get these metals leaving as a gas and they go, like, out across the universe.
sentences.zh: 所以，你会看到这些金属以气体的形式离开，然后它们前往，比如，宇宙各处。

sentences.en: And so, I mean, because they're, like, in this gas across the universe, there would have been some minuscule amounts of gold just, like, in the planet.
sentences.zh: 因此，我的意思是，因为它们就像是弥漫在宇宙中的这种气体，所以在行星中会含有微量的黄金。

sentences.en: Um, but you never would have been able to mine it or use it as a currency or, um, like, have gold jewelry.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但你永远无法开采它、将其用作货币，或者，嗯，拥有黄金首饰。

sentences.en: It would not have been common enough if it was not for the later period of our planet's history, which is about 44 billion years ago.
sentences.zh: 如果不是因为我们星球历史上的晚期阶段——大约44亿年前，它就不会如此普遍。

sentences.en: And that's the heavy bombardment period.
sentences.zh: 那就是狂轰滥炸时期。

sentences.en: And that's where these meteors from somewhere way outside of our solar system come into it.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时期，来自我们太阳系之外某个地方的陨石进入了这里。

sentences.en: And a ton of them hit the planet.
sentences.zh: 有大量的陨石撞击了地球。

sentences.en: And they hit the planet and they go deep enough into the planet that they, uh, change its elemental formation.
sentences.zh: 它们撞击地球，并深入地球内部，从而，嗯，改变了地球的元素构成。

sentences.en: And those meteors are carrying most of the gold that we use to do all the stuff we do with gold.
sentences.zh: 而那些陨石携带了我们用来做所有与黄金有关的事情的大部分黄金。

sentences.en: Uh, including inform our, uh, understanding of how money and value work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，包括塑造我们对金钱和价值如何运作的理解。

sentences.en: And if they had missed, who knows what would happen.
sentences.zh: 如果它们当时错过了，谁知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: But because they hit, that is why we think of money the way that we do.
sentences.zh: 但正因为它们击中了，这就是为什么我们对金钱的看法会是现在这样。

sentences.en: So, you know, why is gold associated with money and currency at all?
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，为什么黄金会完全与金钱和货币联系在一起？

sentences.en: Um, when you think about gold, yeah, you can use it for a billion things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当你想到黄金时，是的，你可以用它来做无数的事情。

sentences.en: You can hammer it into, you know, gold leaf and put it on the top of the Capitol building.
